sentences.en: TUTOR: Hello, Sandy
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 你好，桑迪。

sentences.en: How have you been getting on with your dissertation?
sentences.zh: 你论文进展如何？

sentences.en: SANDY: Fine, and I've been working hard on the various action points we agreed on our last tutorial
sentences.zh: SANDY: 很好，而且我一直努力完成我们上次辅导课上商定的各项行动要点。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Do you want to talk me through what you've done?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 你想跟我详细说说你已完成的工作吗？

sentences.en: SANDY: Yeah, sure
sentences.zh: SANDY: 好的，当然可以。

sentences.en: Well, we agreed on three main targets for me to aim for
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们当时确定了三个主要目标供我努力达成。

sentences.en: The first one was to find out about suitable data analysis software
sentences.zh: 第一个目标是了解适合的数据分析软件。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Yes
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 对。

sentences.en: SANDY: And what I decided to do was to look through catalogues specialising 021 in IT
sentences.zh: SANDY: 我决定查阅专门面向信息技术（IT）领域的目录。

sentences.en: TUTOR: That's a good idea
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 这是个好主意。

sentences.en: What did you come up with?
sentences.zh: 你找到了什么结果？

sentences.en: SANDY: I found the names of two promising ones
sentences.zh: SANDY: 我找到了两款颇具潜力的软件名称。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Right
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 好的。

sentences.en: SANDY: But I also thought it'd be worthwhile talking to a lecturer
sentences.zh: SANDY: 但我也觉得，与一位讲师交流一番会很有价值。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Oh right
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 哦，明白了。

sentences.en: Who did you see?
sentences.zh: 你见了哪位讲师？

sentences.en: SANDY: Jane Prince
sentences.zh: SANDY: 简·普林斯。

sentences.en: Do you know her?
sentences.zh: 你认识她吗？

sentences.en: She's in the Computer Centre
sentences.zh: 她在计算机中心。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Yes, of course, she's the new Head
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 是的，当然认识，她正是新任主管。

sentences.en: SANDY: Yes
sentences.zh: SANDY: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, she was very helpful
sentences.zh: 嗯，她非常乐于助人。

sentences.en: SLA
sentences.zh: SLA

sentences.en: TUTOR: Oh, that's good
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 哦，那太好了。

sentences.en: Did she suggest anything in particular?
sentences.zh: 她有没有特别推荐什么？

sentences.en: SANDY: Yeah
sentences.zh: SANDY: 有。

sentences.en: She recommended software called Vivat and said I should book C.com up for a couple of practice sessions using Vivat
sentences.zh: 她推荐了一款名为‘Vivat’的软件，并建议我预约C.com平台，用Vivat进行几次练习操作。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Great
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 太棒了。

sentences.en: I'm sure you'll find them useful
sentences.zh: 我相信这些练习对你一定很有帮助。

sentences.en: SANDY: And, of course, the second target was to draw up a survey checklist which I
sentences.zh: SANDY: 还有，当然，第二个目标是拟定一份调查清单，我……

sentences.en: TUTOR: Yes, you emailed me it last week
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 对，你上周已通过电子邮件发给我了。

sentences.en: SANDY: Have you had a chance to look ...?
sentences.zh: SANDY: 你有机会看过吗……？

sentences.en: TUTOR: Of course, um think it's good
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 当然有，嗯……我觉得这份清单很好。

sentences.en: Very much on the right lines
sentences.zh: 整体思路完全正确。

sentences.en: I'd say your first two sections are spot on. wouldn't suggest that you change anything there, but in section three you really do need to have questions on teaching experience
sentences.zh: 我认为你的前两个部分非常到位，这部分我建议你无需做任何修改；但在第三部分，你确实需要加入有关教学经验的问题。

sentences.en: SANDY: Yeah
sentences.zh: SANDY: 是的。

sentences.en: I was thinking that section looked a bit short
sentences.zh: 我当时就觉得这一部分看起来有点简短。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Right
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 好的。

sentences.en: SANDY: And my third target was, do further reading on discipline
sentences.zh: SANDY: 而我的第三个目标是就学科领域开展进一步的阅读。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Oh yes
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: I mentioned a couple of writers, didn't I?
sentences.zh: 我提到了几位作家，对吧？

sentences.en: SANDY: Yes, well I got hold of the Banerjee and thought that was excellent
sentences.zh: SANDY: 是的，我拿到了班纳吉（Banerjee）的那本，觉得写得非常出色。

sentences.en: But I'm afraid I didn't manage to get hold of the essays about classroom management - you know, the ones by Simon Ericsson
sentences.zh: 但恐怕我没找到关于课堂管理的那些文章——就是西蒙·埃里克松（Simon Ericsson）写的那些。

sentences.en: The 025 bookshop said it was out of print and the library doesn't have copy
sentences.zh: 025书店说这本书已绝版，图书馆也没有藏书。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Oh right, and I'm afraid I've lent my copy to another student
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 哦，明白了；很抱歉，我的那本已经借给另一位学生了。

sentences.en: What I suggest you do is try the library again - this time apply for it through the service called special loans
sentences.zh: 我建议你再试一次图书馆——这次通过名为‘特藏借阅’（special loans）的服务申请。

sentences.en: Have you done that before?
sentences.zh: 你以前办过这个手续吗？

sentences.en: You're entitled to six books a year
sentences.zh: 你每年有权借阅六本书。

sentences.en: SANDY: Yes
sentences.zh: SANDY: 是的。

sentences.en: No problem
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: That's what I'll do
sentences.zh: 那我就这么办。

sentences.en: TUTOR: So, lots of useful work done
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 所以，你已完成大量有益的工作。

sentences.en: TUTOR: So, let's look at some new targets
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 那么，我们来设定一些新的目标。

sentences.en: We'll start by having a chat about your Chapter One. very much enjoyed reading it
sentences.zh: 我们先聊聊你的第一章。我读得非常愉快。

sentences.en: Your written style is very clear and you've included lots of interesting descriptions of education in your target area
sentences.zh: 你的写作风格非常清晰，并且包含了大量关于你目标地区教育状况的有趣描述。

sentences.en: I've just got a couple of suggestions for some additional work
sentences.zh: 我仅就一些补充性工作提出几点建议。

sentences.en: SANDY: of course
sentences.zh: SANDY: 当然可以。

sentences.en: Could I just ask what do you think I should call it?
sentences.zh: 我能问一下，您觉得我该给它起个什么标题呢？

sentences.en: TUTOR: Well, I'd go for something like Context Review
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 嗯，我建议用类似‘背景综述’（Context Review）这样的标题。

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得如何？

sentences.en: SANDY: Well, short and to the point
sentences.zh: SANDY: 嗯，简洁明了。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Exactly
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 没错。

sentences.en: Now, as regards specific areas to work on, I'd be quite interested to have a few more statistics about the schools in the different zones
sentences.zh: 接下来，关于需要具体加强的部分，我特别希望看到更多有关不同区域学校的一些统计数据。

sentences.en: SANDY: Oh, that wouldn't be a problem
sentences.zh: SANDY: 哦，这不成问题。

sentences.en: I can get them from the Internet
sentences.zh: 我可以从互联网上获取这些数据。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Great, and although you did make a reference to quite a few different writers, think you should aim to cite more works written later than 2000
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 太好了；虽然你确实提到了不少不同作者，但我认为你还应多引用一些2000年之后出版的著作。

sentences.en: SANDY: OK
sentences.zh: SANDY: 好的。

sentences.en: That's more difficult, but I can try
sentences.zh: 这难度更大些，但我可以试试。

sentences.en: When do you want that done by?
sentences.zh: 您希望什么时候完成呢？

sentences.en: TUTOR: Oh, it's not urgent
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 哦，不着急。

sentences.en: Um I should aim for the end of term
sentences.zh: 嗯……我建议你争取在本学期结束前完成。

sentences.en: But in the meantime, I think you should also be thinking about Chapter Two
sentences.zh: 不过与此同时，你也应该开始思考第二章的内容了。

sentences.en: SANDY: Should be drafting it already?
sentences.zh: SANDY: 我现在就应该开始起草第二章了吗？

sentences.en: TUTOR: No, but think you should note down its main sections
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 不必，但你应该先列出它的主要章节。

sentences.en: SANDY: Yes
sentences.zh: SANDY: 好的。

sentences.en: You know, I always find that the hardest part
sentences.zh: 您知道，我总觉得这是最难的部分。

sentences.en: me
sentences.zh: me

sentences.en: TUTOR: always find it helpful to put some ideas on index cards
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 我一直觉得把一些想法记在索引卡上很有帮助。

sentences.en: SANDY: Yeah
sentences.zh: SANDY: 是的。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Um . . . and then you can sort them, and even lay them out on the floor
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 嗯……然后你可以对它们进行分类，甚至把它们铺在地板上。

sentences.en: It's a real help
sentences.zh: 这确实很有帮助。

sentences.en: SANDY: Well, I'll certainly try it!
sentences.zh: SANDY: 好吧，我一定会试试的！

sentences.en: When would the deadline be for that?
sentences.zh: 那截止日期是什么时候？

sentences.en: TUTOR: My advice would be to get it done before you embark upon the research
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 我的建议是在你开始研究之前就完成这项工作。

sentences.en: You can always change it later if you need to
sentences.zh: 如果需要的话，你之后随时可以修改。

sentences.en: SANDY: OK
sentences.zh: SANDY: 好的。

sentences.en: I'll get going on that then
sentences.zh: 那我就马上着手去做这件事了。
